decision_notes: The current successor council website designates its YouTube service. A plenary review report and an Administration/Fire Committee meeting from its fourth extraordinary session were visually reviewed at1200 seconds in Chromium and WebKit, with advancing decoded video, members speaking in the identified chambers and successor-council branding. An interpreter is visible in the plenary sample. This confirms selected recorded proceedings of the integrated council, separately from predecessor archives; current live, every room and all language tracks remain unverified.

Official council website link only. Its own site designates the video provider. A separate, current audiovisual reuse permission was not established from the reviewed own navigation; the sparse identity item is not a reuse licence. Retain permission pending and do not embed, rehost or export provider streams.
